name: Chunk 1/1

raw_entities.name: Enhanced KYC Implementation Register
raw_entities.description: A comprehensive implementation register documenting the rollout of enhanced Know Your Customer procedures across the bank as of March 2026. The register tracks completion of KYC requirements including beneficial ownership verification above 25%, transaction monitoring for funds above £10,000, enhanced screening workflows, and quarterly review cycles. Implementation status is marked as complete with ongoing monitoring.
context: Compliance sampled 12 high-risk files on 2026-03-04 with all required evidence.
The first quarterly monitoring report is due to the Board Risk Committee on 2026-06-30.

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Owner Verification Above 25% Threshold
raw_entities.description: A KYC requirement mandating identification and verification of beneficial owners holding stakes above 25% in customer entities. Implementation is gated through Policy v2 and SOP v3, with completion confirmed on 2026-02-20 and sampled assurance provided.
context: Owners above 25% | Policy v2 and SOP v3 gate

raw_entities.name: Transaction Monitoring for Funds Above £10,000
raw_entities.description: A KYC control requiring enhanced scrutiny and documentation for customer transactions exceeding £10,000. Implementation uses a standardised form and checklist, owned by Retail Banking, completed on 2026-02-22 with sampled assurance.

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Screening Workflow
raw_entities.description: A Financial Crime Department workflow implementing enhanced screening procedures as part of the KYC implementation. The workflow was completed on 2026-02-18 and has been subject to sampled assurance review.

raw_entities.name: Quarterly KYC Review Cycle
raw_entities.description: A mandatory quarterly review process embedded in the KYC system rules to ensure ongoing compliance and refresh of customer due diligence. Owned by the CTO, the first cycle was completed on 2026-02-24 with assurance pending from the first monitoring cycle.

raw_entities.name: Enhanced KYC Training Completion
raw_entities.description: A mandatory training programme on enhanced KYC procedures completed by 84 staff members across the bank. Owned by Compliance, training was completed on 2026-02-26 with full assurance.

raw_entities.name: First Quarterly KYC Monitoring Report to Board Risk Committee
raw_entities.description: A scheduled reporting obligation requiring submission of the first quarterly KYC monitoring report to the Board Risk Committee. The report is due on 2026-06-30 and will document ongoing compliance with enhanced KYC requirements.
context: The first quarterly monitoring report is due to the Board Risk Committee on 2026-06-30.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk File Sampling Review 2026-03-04
raw_entities.description: A compliance sampling exercise conducted on 2026-03-04 reviewing 12 high-risk customer files to verify completeness of required KYC evidence. All sampled files contained the required evidence, confirming effective implementation of enhanced KYC controls.
context: Compliance sampled 12 high-risk files on 2026-03-04 with all required evidence.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Department
raw_entities.description: The department responsible for overseeing the Enhanced KYC Implementation Register, including policy development, staff training, and file sampling assurance. The Head of Compliance is the document owner.

raw_entities.name: Retail Banking Department
raw_entities.description: The department responsible for implementing transaction monitoring controls for funds above £10,000, including form and checklist procedures. Completion was confirmed on 2026-02-22.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Department
raw_entities.description: The department responsible for implementing and maintaining the enhanced screening workflow as part of the KYC implementation. The workflow was completed on 2026-02-18.

raw_entities.name: Staff Completing Enhanced KYC Training
raw_entities.description: A cohort of 84 bank employees who completed the mandatory enhanced KYC training programme on 2026-02-26. Training completion provides assurance of staff capability to execute enhanced KYC procedures.
